fnol_text: My name is Tomas Thorne and I live at 318 Foxglove Way, Greenville, SC 29611. You can reach me on (555) 424-1912 or tomas.thorne@example.com. Heavy rain all afternoon on 16 March 2025. Water pooled on the lawn and then came into the lounge at floor level. Carpets and the sofa are soaked. Policy HH-2025-00080. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Thorne on (555) 424-1912 to acknowledge the claim. Tomas confirmed the loss date as 16 March 2025.
Site visit to 318 Foxglove Way. Neighbour Jordan Delgado was present and confirmed the timeline.
Tomas sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
